threadfox-lite.description: Free, read-only Reddit research tools (MIT): a subreddit's rules with self-promotion rules flagged, communities for a topic, an account's standing and whether a post is still live. Never posts, votes or changes anything; no Reddit API keys. Setup: requires uv (for uvx) and, once, Microsoft's Playwright Extension in the Chrome where you are signed in to Reddit; the first read asks you to pick a tab. See https://github.com/amflimited/threadfox-lite#readme
